summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its half-year 2026 results. The report covers routine financial performance, new business profit growth, and capital returns, including an incremental $0.3 billion share buyback on top of previously announced programs. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is the primary focus; the filing is an ordinary earnings update. The mention of increased stakes and an acquisition are part of ongoing operations, not the filing's core event. Thus, it does not qualify as a special situation under the given categories.
